description:
The proposals comprise sensitive internal repair and refurbishment works to a Grade 2 listed building used as the London headquarters of Mangera Yvars Architects (MYAA). The works take a deliberate light-touch approach across the building's four floors, prioritising structural repair and modest functional improvements whilst preserving the building's historic character.
- Structural repair to deflecting internal floors and central staircase.
- Restoration and repainting of existing wall decorations, skirtings, cornices, stairs, doors in keeping with the building's original historic character.
- New oak timber floorboards laid over floors and stairs throughout.
- Replacement of existing lead pipes with new internal plumbing and drainage.
- Partial removal of a recently added partition wall at upper ground floor to create an open lobby and exhibition space.
- Addition of a door to an existing partition at second floor level to improve means of escape.
- New WC facilities and staff shower at lower ground and first and second floor levels.
